posts.post_caption:
China's AI stock boom just popped: the STAR50 index of AI and chip leaders fell about 40% in under four months and erased roughly $480 billion, Reuters reports. Wall Street's AI stocks have only slipped about 6% by comparison. Is the US next, or is this a China only problem?

Source: Reuters, Geo News · Photos: Reuters, Dado Ruvic / Reuters, Davide Bonaldo / Shutterstock, Geo News
